title: Marco-o1 v2: Towards Widening The Distillation Bottleneck for Reasoning Models
authors_zh: Huifeng Yin；Yu Zhao；Minghao Wu；Xuanfan Ni；Bo Zeng；Hao Wang；Tianqi Shi；Liangying Shao；Chenyang Lyu；Longyue Wang；Weihua Luo；Kaifu Zhang
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: An open reasoning pipeline connecting MCTS chain-of-thought search to SFT and DPO data construction.
Marco-o1 v2 从头用 MCTS 构造树状 CoT 数据，再结合思考长度平衡、细粒度 DPO 和联合后训练目标缓解长推理蒸馏瓶颈。
why: It is a direct example of multi-stage search trace reuse; audit depends on retaining the search tree and preference-pair derivation, not only final demonstrations.
inclusion_reason: It is a direct example of multi-stage search trace reuse; audit depends on retaining the search tree and preference-pair derivation, not only final demonstrations.

title: Problem
问题
html: Directly distilling very long chain-of-thought from large reasoning models can exceed the learning capacity of smaller models and can transfer repetitive reflection, stalled reasoning, or failure to emit a final answer. Marco-o1 v2, published at ACL 2025, reframes this as both a data-construction and post-training problem: build tree-structured traces with ordinary instruction models, then choose path lengths and preference pairs that do not reward formalistic long-time thinking. The atlas data objects are MCTS trees with typed thought nodes, rule-checked terminal answers, extracted correct paths of different relative lengths, and positive/negative pairs for SFT and DPO. A card-worthy claim therefore depends on the tree and pair lineage, not only on downstream benchmark scores or the availability of a model checkpoint.

直接从大型推理模型蒸馏超长 chain-of-thought，可能超出小模型的学习能力，并传递重复反思、推理停滞或无法输出最终答案等行为。发表于 ACL 2025 的 Marco-o1 v2 将其重新表述为数据构造与后训练的共同问题：先用普通指令模型构建树状轨迹，再选择不会奖励 formalistic long-time thinking 的路径长度与偏好对。图谱中的数据对象包括带类型的 thought nodes 所组成的 MCTS 树、经规则检查的终局答案、按相对长度抽取的正确路径，以及供 SFT 和 DPO 使用的正负样本对。因此，可收录的主张必须依赖搜索树和偏好对的血缘，而不能只依赖下游 benchmark 分数或模型 checkpoint 是否存在。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Marco-o1 v2 defines task-specific transition templates over nodes such as Sub-Task, Thinking, Reflection, Hypothesis, Double-Check, Reclarify, and Answer, then uses MCTS to explore allowed transitions. Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct generates ordinary thought content, while Llama3.1-70B-Instruct is used for Reflection nodes; rule-based correctness at Answer nodes supplies the terminal reward and can trigger backtracking. From the completed trees, all valid answer-reaching paths are grouped by relative token length. The longest correct paths are used for SFT, short correct paths serve as chosen DPO examples, and incorrect paths sharing the shortest common prefix provide rejected examples. CoT-aware optimization adds length balance, conservative DPO, mask-based DPO on the differentiating suffix, and a joint DPO-plus-SFT loss. The feedback contract is mixed because rule-checkable terminal answers are combined with model-generated thought and reflection content.

Marco-o1 v2 为 Sub-Task、Thinking、Reflection、Hypothesis、Double-Check、Reclarify 和 Answer 等节点定义任务相关的转移模板，再用 MCTS 探索允许的转移。Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 生成普通思考内容，Llama3.1-70B-Instruct 用于 Reflection 节点；Answer 节点的规则正确性提供终局 reward，并可触发回溯。搜索完成后，所有到达正确答案的有效路径按相对 token 长度分组。最长正确路径用于 SFT，较短正确路径作为 DPO chosen 样本，与其拥有最短共同前缀的错误路径作为 rejected 样本。CoT-aware 优化进一步加入长度平衡、conservative DPO、只作用于差异后缀的 mask-based DPO，以及 DPO 与 SFT 联合损失。反馈契约为 mixed，因为可规则检查的终局答案与模型生成的思考、反思内容共同参与流程。

title: Method
方法
html:
Each prompt starts at a root and is expanded through a sampled reasoning-flow template represented by a node-transition matrix. MCTS selects nodes with an upper-confidence rule, prompts the model according to the node role, and rolls out until an Answer node. A correct rule-checked answer receives terminal reward and is backpropagated; an incorrect answer can return to an earlier node and invoke Reflection. The paper uses Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for Thinking-like nodes and Llama3.1-70B-Instruct for Reflection, so generator and critic are separated but both remain model-mediated. The complete prompt-source manifest, per-domain checker implementation, search limit, rollout count, sampling temperature, tree seeds, and full raw tree corpus are not established by the verified public artifacts.

For post-training, valid correct paths are bucketed by relative length per question rather than by a global token threshold. The paper uses long correct paths for SFT and short correct paths for DPO; negative paths are selected from incorrect branches with the shortest common prefix to a positive path. Conservative DPO softens potentially noisy preference labels, mask-based DPO excludes the shared prefix from gradient computation, and the joint objective is L_DPO plus alpha times L_SFT, with the reported later configuration using alpha=1. The experiments start from a Llama-3.1-8B model fine-tuned on the constructed CoT data and also test transfer through Llama and Qwen models. The official GitHub repository points to Marco-o1 model resources, but the checked evidence does not establish a released row-level v2 tree corpus with branch scores, rejected paths, pair identifiers, and checker logs.

每个提示从 root 开始，依据用节点转移矩阵表示的随机 reasoning-flow template 展开。MCTS 用 upper-confidence 规则选择节点，按节点角色提示模型，并 rollout 到 Answer 节点。经规则检查的正确答案获得终局 reward 并回传；错误答案可回到较早节点并触发 Reflection。论文使用 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 处理 Thinking 类节点，使用 Llama3.1-70B-Instruct 处理 Reflection，因此 generator 与 critic 分离，但二者仍由模型介导。已核实公开 artifact 未确定完整提示来源清单、各领域 checker 实现、搜索上限、rollout 数、采样温度、tree seed 或完整原始树语料。

后训练阶段按每个问题的相对长度对有效正确路径分桶，而不是使用全局 token 阈值。论文将长正确路径用于 SFT、短正确路径用于 DPO；负路径选自与正路径拥有最短共同前缀的错误分支。Conservative DPO 对可能有噪声的偏好标签进行软化，mask-based DPO 排除共享前缀的梯度，联合目标为 L_DPO 加 alpha 倍 L_SFT，论文后续配置采用 alpha=1。实验从用所构造 CoT 数据微调的 Llama-3.1-8B 开始，并在 Llama 与 Qwen 模型上测试迁移。官方 GitHub 仓库指向 Marco-o1 模型资源，但已核实证据不能证明已发布逐行 v2 搜索树语料及其分支分数、拒绝路径、pair 标识与 checker 日志。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper evaluates the constructed data and post-training methods on GSM8K, MATH/MATH500, AIME, Blocksworld, and multilingual Multi-IF. Table 4 reports that SFT on the constructed data improves several studied Llama and Qwen baselines, while Sky-T1 can underperform on the smaller models in this setup. Table 5 is also a warning rather than a monotonic success story: plain DPO sharply degrades several planning and instruction-following scores, after which cDPO, the joint loss, and masking recover different portions. On MATH, the reported best model moves from Test@1/8/32 of 51.0/70.2/79.2 to 51.0/70.8/82.8 when MCTS decoding is added. These experiments support the interaction among data path choice, preference construction, and optimizer design, but they do not prove the correctness of individual thought nodes or the completeness of the public data release.

论文在 GSM8K、MATH/MATH500、AIME、Blocksworld 和多语 Multi-IF 上评估所构造数据与后训练方法。表 4 报告，在多组 Llama、Qwen 基线上用该数据进行 SFT 可提升若干指标，而 Sky-T1 在本设置的小模型上可能表现更差。表 5 同时构成警示，而不是单调成功结论：普通 DPO 会显著降低若干规划与指令跟随分数，随后 cDPO、联合损失和 masking 分别恢复不同部分。在 MATH 上，论文报告最佳模型的 Test@1/8/32 为 51.0/70.2/79.2，加入 MCTS decoding 后变为 51.0/70.8/82.8。这些实验支持数据路径选择、偏好构造与 optimizer 设计之间存在相互作用，但不能证明单个 thought node 正确，也不能证明公开数据发布完整。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Compared with direct distillation of one long teacher trace, Marco-o1 v2 constructs multiple paths from scratch under a typed, configurable reasoning graph and uses rule outcomes to backtrack. Compared with MCTS recipes that only keep a best trajectory or train a process reward model, it explicitly reuses path length and branch overlap to form different SFT targets and fine-grained DPO pairs. The strongest direction signal is this linkage from search structure to the training record: node role, terminal rule result, relative length, common-prefix boundary, and chosen/rejected status have distinct meanings. MCTS, reflection prompting, DPO, cDPO, and joint SFT-preference objectives are prior components; the paper's contribution is their CoT-aware assembly and analysis. It does not establish that predefined node roles mirror human reasoning, or that shorter correct paths are universally better supervision.

与直接蒸馏单条长 teacher trace 相比，Marco-o1 v2 在带类型、可配置的 reasoning graph 下从头构造多条路径，并利用规则结果回溯。与只保留最佳轨迹或训练 process reward model 的 MCTS 配方相比，它明确复用路径长度与分支重叠关系，形成不同的 SFT target 和细粒度 DPO pair。最重要的方向信号是搜索结构与训练记录之间的连接：节点角色、终局规则结果、相对长度、共同前缀边界以及 chosen/rejected 状态各有不同含义。MCTS、reflection prompting、DPO、cDPO 与 SFT-偏好联合目标都是既有组件；论文贡献在于其 CoT-aware 组合与分析。论文没有证明预定义节点角色等同于人类推理，也没有证明较短正确路径始终是更好的监督。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Rule-based rewards only cover tasks for which an answer can be normalized and checked; open-ended instruction-following and planning may require different predicates. Qwen-generated thoughts and Llama-generated reflections can share model biases, and a correct final answer does not validate every intermediate node. Relative length buckets may confound task difficulty with verbosity, while preference pairs derived from the shortest common prefix inherit any checker or search error. The verified paper and repository do not fully disclose prompt sources, data volume, split and decontamination procedures, full search settings, row-level tree lineage, or v2 dataset licensing. The public repository also spans multiple Marco-o1 versions, so a model or v1 demonstration link must not be treated as proof that the v2 training trees and DPO pairs are released. Benchmark improvements do not establish data quality.

规则 reward 只覆盖能够归一化并检查答案的任务；开放式指令跟随与规划可能需要不同判定。Qwen 生成的思考与 Llama 生成的反思仍可能共享模型偏差，而最终答案正确不能验证每个中间节点。相对长度分桶可能把任务难度与冗长度混在一起，基于最短共同前缀构造的偏好对也会继承 checker 或搜索错误。已核实论文与仓库未完整披露提示来源、数据规模、split 与去污染流程、完整搜索设置、逐行 tree lineage 或 v2 数据许可证。公开仓库同时包含多个 Marco-o1 版本，因此模型或 v1 demonstration 链接不能被当作 v2 训练树与 DPO pair 已发布的证据。Benchmark 提升不能证明数据质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the rollout/search/test-time-trace track, Marco-o1 v2 is a concrete example of turning one search tree into several downstream data products: long-path SFT targets, short-path preferences, rejected near-prefix branches, and test-time MCTS candidates. An auditable record should preserve the source prompt, node-transition template, generator model per node, prompt and decoding settings, parent-child IDs, node role and text, rule-check result, reward and backpropagation, stopping reason, all accepted and rejected paths, relative-length bucket, common-prefix mask, and final training split. This schema can support SFT, DPO, search-policy analysis, and verifier audits while keeping terminal correctness separate from model-written reflection quality.

对 rollout/search/test-time-trace 轨道而言，Marco-o1 v2 具体展示了如何把一棵搜索树转化为多种下游数据产品：长路径 SFT targets、短路径偏好、共享近前缀的 rejected branches，以及测试时 MCTS candidates。可审计记录应保留源提示、节点转移模板、各节点 generator 模型、提示与解码设置、父子 ID、节点角色与文本、规则检查结果、reward 与回传、停止原因、全部接受和拒绝路径、相对长度分桶、共同前缀 mask 和最终训练 split。该 schema 可支持 SFT、DPO、搜索策略分析与 verifier 审计，同时把终局正确性与模型生成 reflection 的质量分开。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Typed thought nodes and transition templates constrain the MCTS search space.
  • Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct generates thought content; Llama3.1-70B-Instruct handles Reflection nodes.
  • Rule-checked answers provide terminal reward, while intermediate text remains model-generated.
  • Long correct paths feed SFT; short correct and near-prefix incorrect paths form DPO pairs.
  • The verified public artifacts do not establish a complete row-level v2 tree and preference release.

• 带类型的 thought nodes 与转移模板约束 MCTS 搜索空间。
  • Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 生成思考内容，Llama3.1-70B-Instruct 处理 Reflection 节点。
  • 规则检查答案提供终局 reward，中间文本仍由模型生成。
  • 长正确路径用于 SFT，短正确路径与共享近前缀的错误路径组成 DPO pair。
  • 已核实公开 artifact 不能证明完整逐行 v2 搜索树与偏好数据已经发布。
